title: OMR official planning evidence ledger
methodology: MITO records only the decision, survey, road and programme facts visible in official CMDA indexes, meeting minutes and office-copy maps. A planning record is linked to a current registration village only when the crosswalk is unambiguous. No record is treated as a village-wide land-use or title statement.
coverageCaveat: These records concern specific surveys, layouts, roads or planning decisions. They do not prove that every parcel in the named village has the same approval or land use.

records.locationEvidence: Official meeting text identifies the street, town survey number and block; MITO has not obtained a verified parcel geometry.
records.summary: CMDA approved a specific residential proposal from the CRZ angle at T.S.No.7/6, Block 14 of Adyar village.
records.scopeCaveat: This is a site-specific CRZ decision from 2007, not proof of current approval or zoning for other Adyar parcels.

records.locationEvidence: The official CMDA index names Okkiyam Thoraipakkam and record 38/2024; the referenced map has not been converted into verified geometry.
records.summary: CMDA lists regularisation layout/framework office copy 38/2024 for Okkiyam Thoraipakkam.
records.scopeCaveat: The index proves the record exists; it does not prove that every plot in the village is regularised.

records.landUseAfter: Residential usage only under the cited regularisation rules
records.planningConstraint: The office copy states that individual plots require separate regularisation and excludes public waterbody land.
records.locationEvidence: The office copy names the village, survey reference and access roads; its layout boundary has not been digitised or independently reconciled.
records.summary: CMDA issued an in-principle layout framework for S.No.209 part and recorded residential-only and waterbody conditions.
records.scopeCaveat: Framework approval is not individual-plot regularisation, title verification or proof that the layout exists on the ground today.

records.scopeCaveat: The resolution applies only to S.No.184 part and must be checked against the current statutory land-use map.

records.planningConstraint: CMDA lists the present-status text as ‘CC’; MITO preserves it without expanding or inferring completion.
